a warm caramel complexion, early 30s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long curly natural black hair — her bare skin rendered from the neck down like a medical X-ray radiograph: her skeleton glowing in luminous cool blue-white across her ribcage, spine, shoulders, arms, pelvis and legs, soft translucent grey-blue flesh around the bones with fine bright outlines at every joint, the glow sitting inside living skin and following every curve beneath it, covering all of her skin from the neck to the ankles and the backs of her hands, her face left unpainted and the glow fading out at the neck. Background: a bright coastal clifftop with a grassy path, a waist-high wooden safety rail, standard-height stone steps and a white lighthouse far behind her, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows on the skin, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor.
